page.overview:
What is Durant?

Durant is a six-legged insect-like Pokémon that resembles an ant. Its body is made of shiny gray metal. It has sharp pincers on its mouth, long gray antennae, and six black legs. It has gleaming red eyes that are squinted, giving it an angry or determined appearance. Its thorax and abdomen are powerfully armored with a metal exoskeleton.

Durant lives in large colonies similar to real-life ants. They are outfitted with metallic armor that helps protect them from Heatmor, one of their natural predators. Durant also has large mandibles that are used as weapons to help fight against Heatmor. Their eggs are the main food source for Sandaconda.

Durant is based on an , most likely an or due to its jaw shape, with a metal exoskeleton. It may also be based on the due to its silver coloration. Its relationship with Heatmor is based on the predator and prey relationship of s and ants. This is also reflected in their types in which Durant's / type is solely weak to the type, the type that Heatmor is.

Its Japanese name, Aianto, comes from iron and ant. It is also reminiscent of Iron ant from the Dragon Quest series.
